summary: Verified slot-based partner availability bug-fix. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_slot_based_availability.py covering MatchingEngine.slot_window / partner_free_for / available_targets (unit-level), GET /api/bookings/partner/jobs, GET /api/bookings/partner/ring-pending slot filters, and POST /api/bookings/{id}/accept 409-on-overlap guard. Seeded synthetic bookings directly into MongoDB (test rows tagged TEST_SLOT_, cleaned up on teardown) because there is NO /api/payments/mock route in the current codebase — payment flow is real-gateway only. All 11 tests PASS.

minor.issue: Review request references POST /api/payments/mock but no such endpoint exists in /app/backend/routes/payment_routes.py — only /order, /verify, /confirm-return. If E2E mock-pay is required for tests/UI demos, add a MOCK gateway path or a dev-only /payments/mock endpoint. Test bypassed it by seeding bookings directly in Mongo.

action_items: Optional: add a dev/mock payments endpoint so full E2E (create -> pay -> searching -> ring) can be tested via HTTP without direct DB seeding.
Optional: engines.available_targets() returns list preserving insertion order — consider adding a docstring test to guarantee ordering contract.
critical_code_review_comments: engines.py:836-838 — when booking is None available_targets falls back to legacy 'any accepted job = busy' behaviour. All existing callers pass a booking, but a future caller forgetting to pass one would silently regress to the old bug. Consider making booking required.

booking_controller.partner_jobs (2200) and partner_ring_pending (2232) call MatchingEngine.partner_free_for per row in a Python loop → N+1 Mongo hits for large feeds. For scale, fetch the partner's ACCEPTED bookings once and reuse across rows.

accept_job (2620) rechecks partner_free_for BEFORE the atomic status update; there's a small race between the check and the update where a partner could accept two overlapping bookings if both requests interleave. Consider making the atomic $set filter also assert no overlap (or wrap in a Mongo transaction).

slot_window uses a hard-coded 30-min fallback in three places (engines.py 792, 800, 806) — safe today, but if _slot_cfg is ever misconfigured a partner could be silently over- or under-blocked. Log a warning when the fallback fires.
test_credentials: Demo partner +919000000003 / OTP 123456 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test used direct Mongo access via MONGO_URL from /app/backend/.env for seed/cleanup.
seed_data_creation: All test bookings prefixed TEST_SLOT_ (codes TEST_SLOT_A/B/C/D/INSTANT). Fixture-level teardown removes them. Verified DB is clean post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_slot_based_availability.py -v -n 0. Test file uses a persistent asyncio event loop (motor caches its io_loop on first use). It sets partner +919000000003 online at module scope; if a later test toggles it offline, prepend that step. There is no /api/payments/mock route — do NOT try to hit it. If you need to test the payment->searching path, seed bookings in Mongo (schema shown in _mk_booking) or add a mock gateway endpoint first.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verified a bug-fix already applied. Prior bug: engines.available_targets excluded any partner with any accepted booking regardless of slot, so a partner with a future accepted booking was blocked from all alerts. Fix (engines.py 811-852, 855-873): compute the target booking's [start,end) slot window and only mark a partner busy if one of their accepted bookings' slot windows OVERLAPS the target window (half-open interval overlap `ns<ee and es<ne`). Instant/'now' bookings occupy [now, now+step) so they never conflict with future scheduled bookings. All 11 tests pass, confirming: (1) accepted future scheduled booking still allows alerts for other slots (unit + HTTP), (2) overlapping-slot booking correctly hidden and returns 409 on accept, (3) non-overlapping accept succeeds, multiple non-overlap accepts stack, (4) instant in-progress job doesn't block future scheduled offers but does block new now-jobs.
